spec.description:
Foilboard Green is a rigid, Australian-manufactured insulation
panel constructed from a fire-retardant expanded polystyrene (EPS) core
laminated on both sides with pure aluminum foil facings. Engineered for use in
roofs, external and internal walls, retrofits, and suspended underfloor
applications, it provides a 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and
moisture barrier. Available in ratings from R1.6 to R4.0 across 10mm to 50mm
thicknesses, it achieves high Total R-values when paired with adjacent
reflective airspaces.
features:
3-in-1 insulation, thermal break, and
moisture barrier in a single rigid panel

Fire-retardant expanded polystyrene
(EPS) core with pure aluminum foil facings

Pure aluminum reflective facings
reflect up to 97% of radiant heat

Achieves system Total R-values up to R4.0+
in conjunction with adjacent airspaces

Zero harmful fibers; non-allergenic
and non-carcinogenic with no itch

Extremely lightweight, rigid, and fast to
cut and install on site

Impermeable to moisture and will not sag, rot, or
deteriorate over time

Anti-glare coating on one face for safe installation in
bright sunlight

Group 1 fire hazard rating compliant with AS 5637.1 / AS
ISO 9705 for ceilings/walls

Backed by an Australian 25-year performance
warranty

install:
Ensure structural framing or substrate is level,
clean, and dry

Measure and cut panels using a sharp utility knife or hand
saw

Install panels with a minimum 20mm air space adjacent to reflective foil
faces to generate full thermal R-value

For walls, fix horizontally or
vertically across timber/steel framing with mechanical fasteners and blank
plates

For underfloor, install between joists supported on Foilboard Floor
Saddles

Butt sheet joints tightly and tape with Foilboard 72mm reinforced
aluminum tape

Seal all edges around windows, doors, and service penetrations
to maintain airtightness

Ensure anti-glare green face faces the installer
during roof and sunny external installations
selection_checklist:
Determine required Total R-value (R1.6 to R4.0) to meet NCC or NatHERS
targets

Select board thickness (10mm to 50mm) based on available cavity
depth
Verify minimum 20mm reflective air space can be maintained in the assembly
Order matching installation accessories (Floor Saddles, Flexifast, 72mm tape)
limitations:
Requires a sealed air space of at least 20mm adjacent to foil
face to deliver rated Total R-value

Avoid contact with organic solvents,
petroleum fuels, and solvent-based adhesives which dissolve EPS

Do not leave
permanently exposed to direct outdoor UV weather without cladding

problem_keywords: winter heat loss through timber floors
use_cases:
Underfloor insulation between joists in suspended timber floor
homes to eliminate draughts and cold floors

Continuous external wall thermal
break and insulation behind brick veneer or lightweight cladding

Lining
internal walls and ceilings of domestic garages, workshops, and metal sheds
Insulating cathedral and raked ceilings where cavity depth is restricted
not_for: Continuous water immersion or subterranean hydrostatic tanking
Direct foot traffic without floorboards or overlay
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard Green is a rigid Australian-made
insulation board composed of a fire-retardant EPS core laminated with pure
aluminum foil facings on both sides. Available in thicknesses from 10mm to 50mm
(Total R-values from R1.6 to R4.0+ when paired with airspaces), it acts as a
combined thermal insulator, thermal break, and vapor barrier across walls,
roofs, sheds, and suspended timber floors. Fiber-free, moisture-impermeable,
non-allergenic, and tested to Group 1 fire standards, it delivers lifetime
thermal efficiency backed by a 25-year performance warranty.
